view_note: The game view is y 299..872 (573 px), measured by the row-brightness edge at y=299 and y=875; the brief's 240-680 was approximate. Bounding boxes are in view pixels (576x573). The right TikTok icon column (x>500) and the caption word are NOT editor UI and are ignored.

start.note: editor first frame, dashed spine outline, 53/255

spine_hover.note: 4 blue/yellow spheres appear on the spine in one frame

part_picked.note: part dragged to the body: small pale rings on the target, pink floor marker

part_dropped.note: part attached 2 frames earlier, 'Sell For' tooltip, counter 55/255

spine_drag.note: one yellow (active) and two blue spheres, creature posture changed

part_rotate.note: big blue/white rotate gizmo ring around the part

final.note: last editor frame, 118/255, creature smaller after many adds

finish_painted.note: after the paint step: no pedestal, no UI, creature fills 83% (not scored: our editor has no equivalent yet)

drop_to_puff_s.frames: attach f294, white ring + sparks visible f294-f296
drop_to_puff_s.how: frame stepping f286-f300 at 1 frame; attach = the frame the part is on the body (f294), puff = first frame of the white ring flash on the attach point (f294)

cost_popup_delay_s.how: first frame with the green '+75' text near the part (f301-f302) minus attach f294

cost_popup_life_s.how: popup text rises ~180 px from the paw to the head and is gone by f312; brief C4 asks 600 ms

head_react_delay_s.how: first frame the head pose differs from the idle pose (f301-f302) minus attach f294; roar peak f304

handle_fade_in_s.how: spheres go from absent to opaque in one frame (no fade); fade-out takes f187-f190 (0.14 s). brief C3 asks ~120 ms

counter_tick_vs_attach_s.how: 53/255 -> 55/255 at f290, 4 frames before the part lands (it ticks when the part is picked up over the body); info only

ui.note: editor UI pixels / view pixels: left rail 50 px full height (8.7%), top-left icon cluster ~210x35, counter 55x12, bottom bar 300x18 -> ~13% including the bezel rail, ~4% without it. Hand-measured on f147 with a 50 px grid.

height_frac.note: brief acceptance: creature fills >= 50% of the frame height

ui_coverage.note: brief acceptance: <= 15% with the drawer closed

camera_elev_deg.how: pedestal top ellipse height/width = sin(elevation): 90/440 -> 12 deg on f147; hand-measured, +-4 deg

clutter.how: nothing (grass, rocks) between camera and creature; hand-checked on all 7 frames

measurement_notes: Bounding boxes are hand-annotated on 50 px grid overlays of the frames (the creature is green on a green forest: colour keying is not robust).
Timing is frame stepping at the native 24.17 fps (1 frame = 41 ms), on crops of the part area.
Heights are fractions of the view height (573 px); ours are fractions of the 720 px viewport.
